009

011import fiji.plugin.trackmate.Model;
012import fiji.plugin.trackmate.SelectionModel;
013import fiji.plugin.trackmate.Settings;
014import fiji.plugin.trackmate.Spot;
015import fiji.plugin.trackmate.TrackMate;
016import fiji.plugin.trackmate.TrackModel;
017import fiji.plugin.trackmate.action.CaptureOverlayAction;
018import fiji.plugin.trackmate.detection.LogDetectorFactory;
019import fiji.plugin.trackmate.features.FeatureFilter;
020import fiji.plugin.trackmate.gui.displaysettings.DisplaySettings;
021import fiji.plugin.trackmate.gui.displaysettings.DisplaySettingsIO;
022import fiji.plugin.trackmate.tracking.jaqaman.SparseLAPTrackerFactory;
023import fiji.plugin.trackmate.visualization.hyperstack.HyperStackDisplayer;
024import ij.IJ;
025import ij.ImagePlus;
026import ij.io.FileSaver;
027import loci.common.DebugTools;
028import paint.fiji.tracks.TrackDataExporter;
029import paint.shared.config.TrackMateConfig;
030import paint.ui.dialogs.ProjectDialog;
031import paint.shared.objects.ExperimentInfo;
032import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;
033
034import java.io.File;
035import java.nio.file.Files;
036import java.nio.file.Path;
037import java.time.Duration;
038import java.time.LocalDateTime;
039import java.util.ArrayList;
040import java.util.Arrays;
041import java.util.List;
042import java.util.Locale;
043import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;
044
045/**
046 * Provides functionality to run TrackMate analysis for a single microscopy
047 * recording. Handles setup, detection, tracking, visualization, and export.
048 * <p>
049 * This class is typically invoked by {@link RunTrackMateOnExperiment} as part
050 * of batch processing within a Paint project.
051 * </p>
052 */
053public class RunTrackMateOnRecording {
054
055    /**
056     * Executes the TrackMate pipeline on a given recording.
057     * Loads the ND2 image, applies analysis parameters, and writes results.
058     *
059     * @param experimentPath       directory where results will be written
060     * @param imagesPath           directory containing the ND2 image
061     * @param trackMateConfig      configuration object with TrackMate parameters
062     * @param threshold            threshold for spot detection
063     * @param experimentInfoRecord metadata describing this recording
064     * @param dialog               optional dialog for user cancellation
065     * @return {@link TrackMateResults} containing analysis statistics,
066     *         or a cancellation result if aborted
067     */
068    public static TrackMateResults runTrackMateOnRecording(Path experimentPath,
069            Path            imagesPath,
070            TrackMateConfig trackMateConfig,
071            double          threshold,
072            ExperimentInfo  experimentInfoRecord,
073            ProjectDialog   dialog) {
074
075        LocalDateTime start = LocalDateTime.now();
076        DebugTools.setRootLevel("OFF");
077
078        ImagePlus imp            = null;
079        ImagePlus impBrightfield = null;
080        ImagePlus capture        = null;
081
082        try {
083            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
084            // Step 1 – Load ND2 image
085            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
086            PaintLogger.raw("                       TrackMate - Image Loading:   ");
087            if (isCancelled(Thread.currentThread(), dialog)) {
088                return cancelEarly(imp, impBrightfield);
089            }
090
091            File nd2File = new File(imagesPath.toFile(), experimentInfoRecord.getRecordingName() + ".nd2");
092            if (!nd2File.exists()) {
093                if (!isCancelled(Thread.currentThread(), dialog)) {
094                    PaintLogger.errorf("Could not open image file: %s", nd2File.getAbsolutePath());
095                }
096                return cancelEarly(imp, impBrightfield);
097            }
098
099            try {
100                imp = IJ.openImage(nd2File.getAbsolutePath());
101            } catch (Exception e) {
102                if (!isCancelled(Thread.currentThread(), dialog)) {
103                    PaintLogger.errorf("Could not load image file: %s", nd2File.getAbsolutePath());
104                }
105                return cancelEarly(imp, impBrightfield);
106            }
107
108            if (isCancelled(Thread.currentThread(), dialog)) {
109                return cancelEarly(imp, impBrightfield);
110            }
111
112            if (imp == null) {
113                if (!isCancelled(Thread.currentThread(), dialog)) {
114                    PaintLogger.errorf("Unsupported format or file not found: %s", nd2File);
115                }
116                return cancelEarly(imp, impBrightfield);
117            }
118
119            imp.show();
120            IJ.wait(100);
121
122            IJ.run(imp, "Enhance Contrast", "saturated=0.35");
123            IJ.run("Grays");
124
125            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
126            // Step 2 – Save Brightfield snapshot
127            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
128            Path jpgPath = experimentPath.resolve("Brightfield Images")
129                                         .resolve(experimentInfoRecord.getRecordingName() + ".jpg");
130            if (Files.notExists(jpgPath.getParent())) {
131                Files.createDirectories(jpgPath.getParent());
132            }
133            if (isCancelled(Thread.currentThread(), dialog)) {
134                return cancelEarly(imp, impBrightfield);
135            }
136
137            Path   brightFieldPath = null;
138            String baseName        = experimentInfoRecord.getRecordingName();
139
140            List<String> candidates = Arrays.asList(
141                    baseName + "-BF.nd2",
142                    baseName + "-BF1.nd2",
143                    baseName + "-BF2.nd2");
144            try {
145                brightFieldPath = candidates.stream()
146                                            .map(imagesPath::resolve)
147                                            .filter(Files::exists)
148                                            .findFirst()
149                                            .orElse(null);
150            } catch (Exception e) {
151                PaintLogger.errorf("Could not locate brightfield file: %s", candidates);
152            }
153
154            if (brightFieldPath == null || Files.notExists(brightFieldPath)) {
155                PaintLogger.warnf("      Could not open brightfield file: %s",
156                                  brightFieldPath == null ? "none found" : brightFieldPath.toString());
157            } else {
158                try {
159                    impBrightfield = IJ.openImage(brightFieldPath.toString());
160                    IJ.run(impBrightfield, "Enhance Contrast", "saturated=0.35");
161                    IJ.saveAs(impBrightfield, "Jpeg", jpgPath.toString());
162                } catch (Exception e) {
163                    PaintLogger.errorf("Error handling brightfield file: %s", e.getMessage());
164                }
165            }
166
167            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
168            // Step 3 – Configure TrackMate
169            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
170            Model model = new Model();
171            model.setLogger(Logger.VOID_LOGGER);
172
173            Settings settings = new Settings(imp);
174            // Detector configuration
175            settings.detectorFactory  = new LogDetectorFactory();
176            settings.detectorSettings = settings.detectorFactory.getDefaultSettings();
177            settings.detectorSettings.put("TARGET_CHANNEL",           trackMateConfig.getTargetChannel());
178            settings.detectorSettings.put("RADIUS",                   trackMateConfig.getRadius());
179            settings.detectorSettings.put("DO_SUBPIXEL_LOCALIZATION", trackMateConfig.isDoSubpixelLocalization());
180            settings.detectorSettings.put("THRESHOLD",                threshold);
181            settings.detectorSettings.put("DO_MEDIAN_FILTERING",      trackMateConfig.isMedianFiltering());
182
183            // Tracker configuration
184            settings.trackerFactory  = new SparseLAPTrackerFactory();
185            settings.trackerSettings = settings.trackerFactory.getDefaultSettings();
186            settings.trackerSettings.put("LINKING_MAX_DISTANCE",            trackMateConfig.getLinkingMaxDistance());
187            settings.trackerSettings.put("ALTERNATIVE_LINKING_COST_FACTOR", trackMateConfig.getAlternativeLinkingCostFactor());
188            settings.trackerSettings.put("ALLOW_GAP_CLOSING",               trackMateConfig.isAllowGapClosing());
189            settings.trackerSettings.put("GAP_CLOSING_MAX_DISTANCE",        trackMateConfig.getGapClosingMaxDistance());
190            settings.trackerSettings.put("MAX_FRAME_GAP",                   trackMateConfig.getMaxFrameGap());
191            settings.trackerSettings.put("ALLOW_TRACK_SPLITTING",           trackMateConfig.isAllowTrackSplitting());
192            settings.trackerSettings.put("SPLITTING_MAX_DISTANCE",          trackMateConfig.getSplittingMaxDistance());
193            settings.trackerSettings.put("ALLOW_TRACK_MERGING",             trackMateConfig.isAllowTrackMerging());
194            settings.trackerSettings.put("MERGING_MAX_DISTANCE",            trackMateConfig.getMergingMaxDistance());
195
196            // Locale for consistent number formatting
197            Locale.setDefault(Locale.US);
198            System.setProperty("user.language", "en");
199            System.setProperty("user.country", "US");
200            // These two had no effect on TrackMate's linking (tested 2026-11-05, see
201            // doc/Change Note - TrackMate Determinism and Single Detection.md).
202            // Reproducible linking is controlled by the 'Deterministic Tracking' setting.
203            // System.setProperty("java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinPool.common.parallelism", "1");
204            // System.setProperty("trackmate.deterministic", "true");
205
206            settings.addSpotFilter(new FeatureFilter("QUALITY", 0, true));
207            settings.addAllAnalyzers();
208            settings.addTrackFilter(new FeatureFilter("NUMBER_SPOTS",
209                                                      trackMateConfig.getMinNumberOfSpotsInTrack(),
210                                                      true));
211
212            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
213            // Step 4 – Execute TrackMate
214            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
215
216            if (isCancelled(Thread.currentThread(), dialog)) {
217                return cancelEarly(imp, impBrightfield);
218            }
219
220            TrackMate trackmate = new TrackMate(model, settings);
221            // Multithreaded linking is fast but not reproducible; a single thread is
222            // reproducible but slow. See TrackMateConfig.isDeterministicTracking().
223            if (trackMateConfig.isDeterministicTracking()) {
224                trackmate.setNumThreads(1);
225            }
226            if (!trackmate.checkInput()) {
227                if (!isCancelled(Thread.currentThread(), dialog)) {
228                    PaintLogger.errorf("TrackMate input check failed: %s", trackmate.getErrorMessage());
229                }
230                return cancelEarly(imp, impBrightfield);
231            }
232
233            // ---- Spot detection ----
234            PaintLogger.raw("\n                       TrackMate - spot detection:  ");
235            try {
236                if (!trackmate.execDetection()) {
237                    // If we reach here with an interrupted thread or external cancel,
238                    // treat it as cancellation, not as a hard error.
239                    if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted() || isCancelled(Thread.currentThread(), dialog)) {
240                        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
241                        PaintLogger.warnf("TrackMate spot detection interrupted (cancellation).");
242                        return cancelEarly(imp, impBrightfield);
243                    }
244
245                    PaintLogger.errorf("TrackMate - execDetection failed: %s",
246                                       trackmate.getErrorMessage());
247                    return cancelEarly(imp, impBrightfield);
248                }
249            } catch (Exception e) {
250                // Special handling: InterruptedException often bubbles out of TrackMate
251                // when the watchdog/worker interrupts the thread.
252                if (e instanceof InterruptedException
253                        || Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()
254                        || isCancelled(Thread.currentThread(), dialog)) {
255                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
256                    PaintLogger.warnf("TrackMate spot detection interrupted (likely cancellation).");
257                    return cancelEarly(imp, impBrightfield);
258                }
259
260                PaintLogger.errorf("Unexpected error during detection: %s", e.getMessage());
261                return cancelEarly(imp, impBrightfield);
262            }
263
264            int numberOfSpots = model.getSpots().getNSpots(false);
265            if (numberOfSpots > trackMateConfig.getMaxNumberOfSpotsInImage()) {
266                PaintLogger.warnf("   TrackMate - Too many spots detected (%d). Limit is %d.",
267                                  numberOfSpots, trackMateConfig.getMaxNumberOfSpotsInImage());
268                return cancelEarly(imp, impBrightfield);
269            } else {
270                String numberOfSpotsString = " (" + numberOfSpots + " spots detected) ";
271                PaintLogger.raw(numberOfSpotsString);
272            }
273
274            if (isCancelled(Thread.currentThread(), dialog)) {
275                return cancelEarly(imp, impBrightfield);
276            }
277
278            // ---- Track detection ----
279            PaintLogger.raw("\n                       TrackMate - track detection: ");
280            try {
281                if (!processAfterDetection(trackmate)) {
282
283                    if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted() || isCancelled(Thread.currentThread(), dialog)) {
284                        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
285                        PaintLogger.warnf("TrackMate track detection interrupted (cancellation).");
286                        return cancelEarly(imp, impBrightfield);
287                    }
288
289                    PaintLogger.errorf("TrackMate process failed: %s", trackmate.getErrorMessage());
290                    return cancelEarly(imp, impBrightfield);
291                }
292            } catch (Exception e) {
293                if (e instanceof InterruptedException
294                        || Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()
295                        || isCancelled(Thread.currentThread(), dialog)) {
296                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
297                    PaintLogger.warnf("TrackMate track detection interrupted (likely cancellation).");
298                    return cancelEarly(imp, impBrightfield);
299                }
300
301                PaintLogger.errorf("Unexpected error during TrackMate process: %s", e.getMessage());
302                return cancelEarly(imp, impBrightfield);
303            }
304
305            // Edge tracks: present in the first or last analysed frame, so their real duration
306            // is unknown. Hidden tracks are skipped by the overlay, the count and the tracks CSV.
307            String edgeTracksString;
308            if (trackMateConfig.isExcludeEdgeTracks()) {
309                int numberOfEdgeTracks = excludeEdgeTracks(model, settings.tstart, settings.tend);
310                edgeTracksString = numberOfEdgeTracks + " edge tracks dismissed";
311            } else {
312                edgeTracksString = "edge tracks kept";
313            }
314
315            int numberOfFilteredTracks = model.getTrackModel().nTracks(true);
316            String linkingMode          = trackMateConfig.isDeterministicTracking() ? "deterministic" : "multithreaded";
317            String numberOfTracksString = " (" + numberOfFilteredTracks + " tracks detected, "
318                    + edgeTracksString + ", " + linkingMode + ") ";
319            PaintLogger.raw(numberOfTracksString);
320
321            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
322            // Step 5 – Visualization
323            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
324            if (isCancelled(Thread.currentThread(), dialog)) {
325                return cancelEarly(imp, impBrightfield);
326            }
327
328            final SelectionModel  selectionModel = new SelectionModel(model);
329            final DisplaySettings ds             = DisplaySettingsIO.readUserDefault();
330            ds.setSpotVisible(false);
331            ds.setTrackColorBy(DisplaySettings.TrackMateObject.TRACKS,
332                               trackMateConfig.getTrackColoring());
333            final HyperStackDisplayer displayer = new HyperStackDisplayer(model,
334                                                                          selectionModel,
335                                                                          imp,
336                                                                          ds);
337            displayer.render();
338            displayer.refresh();
339
340            capture = CaptureOverlayAction.capture(imp, -1, 1, null);
341
342            Path imagePath = experimentPath.resolve("TrackMate Images")
343                                           .resolve(experimentInfoRecord.getRecordingName() + ".jpg");
344            if (capture != null) {
345                if (!new FileSaver(capture).saveAsTiff(String.valueOf(imagePath))) {
346                    PaintLogger.errorf("Failed to save TIFF to: %s", imagePath);
347                }
348            }
349            IJ.wait(2000);
350
351            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
352            // Step 6 – Write tracks CSV
353            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
354            String tracksName = experimentInfoRecord.getRecordingName() + "-tracks.csv";
355            Path   tracksPath = experimentPath.resolve(tracksName);
356            int    totalSpotsInAllTracks = 0;
357
358            try {
359                totalSpotsInAllTracks = TrackDataExporter.writeTracksCsv(
360                        trackmate,
361                        experimentInfoRecord.getExperimentName(),
362                        experimentInfoRecord.getRecordingName(),
363                        tracksPath,
364                        true);
365            } catch (Exception e) {
366                PaintLogger.errorf("Failed to write tracks to '%s'", tracksPath);
367            }
368
369            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
370            // Step 7 – Summarize and return results
371            // -----------------------------------------------------------------
372            int numberOfSpotsTotal     = model.getSpots().getNSpots(true);
373            int numberOfTracks         = model.getTrackModel().nTracks(false);
374            // int numberOfFilteredTracks = model.getTrackModel().nTracks(true);
375            int numberOfFrames         = imp.getNFrames();
376
377            Duration duration = Duration.between(start, LocalDateTime.now());
378
379            closeImages(imp, impBrightfield, capture);
380
381            return new TrackMateResults(true,
382                                        true,
383                                        numberOfSpotsTotal,
384                                        numberOfTracks,
385                                        numberOfFilteredTracks,
386                                        numberOfFrames,
387                                        duration,
388                                        totalSpotsInAllTracks);
389
390        } catch (Exception e) {
391            // Any unexpected top-level exception: honor cancellation if present
392            if (e instanceof InterruptedException
393                    || Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()
394                    || isCancelled(Thread.currentThread(), dialog)) {
395                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
396                PaintLogger.warnf("TrackMate recording interrupted (top-level cancellation).");
397                return cancelEarly(imp, impBrightfield);
398            }
399
400            PaintLogger.errorf("Exception during TrackMate processing: %s", e.getMessage());
401            return cancelEarly(imp, impBrightfield);
402        } finally {
403            closeImages(imp, impBrightfield, capture);
404        }
405    }
406
407    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
408    // Utility methods
409    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
410
411    /**
412     * Runs the TrackMate steps that follow spot detection.
413     * <p>
414     * This is {@link TrackMate#process()} without its first step, {@code execDetection()}.
415     * Detection is run separately beforehand, so that the spot count can be checked against
416     * {@code Max Number of Spots in Image} before the expensive tracking starts. Calling
417     * {@code process()} would run detection a second time.
418     * <p>
419     * Same steps, arguments and return behaviour as {@code process()} in TrackMate 7.14.0:
420     * {@code false} as soon as a step fails, {@code true} when cancelled between steps.
421     * Verified to give the same results as {@code process()}; see
422     * {@code doc/Change Note - TrackMate Determinism and Single Detection.md}.
423     * Check this list again when TrackMate is upgraded.
424     *
425     * @param trackmate the TrackMate instance on which {@code execDetection()} has succeeded
426     * @return {@code false} if a step failed, {@code true} otherwise
427     */
428    private static boolean processAfterDetection(TrackMate trackmate) {
429        List<BooleanSupplier> steps = Arrays.asList(
430                trackmate::execInitialSpotFiltering,
431                () -> trackmate.computeSpotFeatures(true),
432                () -> trackmate.execSpotFiltering(true),
433                trackmate::execTracking,
434                () -> trackmate.computeEdgeFeatures(true),
435                () -> trackmate.computeTrackFeatures(true),
436                () -> trackmate.execTrackFiltering(true)
437        );
438        for (BooleanSupplier step : steps) {
439            if (!step.getAsBoolean()) {
440                return false;
441            }
442            if (trackmate.isCanceled()) {
443                return true;
444            }
445        }
446        return true;
447    }
448
449    /**
450     * Hides the tracks that are present in the first or the last analysed frame.
451     * <p>
452     * The real duration of such a track is unknown: it may have started before the recording
453     * began, or continued after it ended. Only tracks that are visible, i.e. that passed
454     * TrackMate's track filters, are considered. Hidden tracks are skipped by the overlay,
455     * by {@code nTracks(true)} and by the tracks CSV ({@code visibleOnly = true}).
456     *
457     * @param model      the TrackMate model after tracking
458     * @param firstFrame the first analysed frame, 0-based ({@code settings.tstart})
459     * @param lastFrame  the last analysed frame, 0-based ({@code settings.tend})
460     * @return the number of tracks hidden
461     */
462    static int excludeEdgeTracks(Model model, int firstFrame, int lastFrame) {
463        TrackModel    trackModel = model.getTrackModel();
464        List<Integer> edgeTracks = new ArrayList<>();
465
466        for (Integer trackId : trackModel.trackIDs(true)) {
467            int start = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
468            int end   = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
469            for (Spot spot : trackModel.trackSpots(trackId)) {
470                int frame = (int) Math.round(spot.getFeature(Spot.FRAME));
471                start = Math.min(start, frame);
472                end   = Math.max(end, frame);
473            }
474            if (start <= firstFrame || end >= lastFrame) {
475                edgeTracks.add(trackId);
476            }
477        }
478
479        model.beginUpdate();
480        try {
481            for (Integer trackId : edgeTracks) {
482                model.setTrackVisibility(trackId, false);
483            }
484        } finally {
485            model.endUpdate();
486        }
487        return edgeTracks.size();
488    }
489
490    /**
491     * Checks for thread interruption or user cancellation.
492     */
493    private static boolean isCancelled(Thread t, ProjectDialog dialog) {
494        return t.isInterrupted() || (dialog != null && dialog.isCancelled());
495    }
496
497    /**
498     * Safely closes visible images.
499     */
500    private static void closeImages(ImagePlus... images) {
501        for (ImagePlus img : images) {
502            try {
503                if (img != null && img.isVisible()) {
504                    img.close();
505                }
506            } catch (Exception e) {
507                PaintLogger.warnf("Error closing image: %s", e.getMessage());
508            }
509        }
510    }
511
512    /**
513     * Cancels processing early and closes images.
514     */
515    private static TrackMateResults cancelEarly(ImagePlus... images) {
516        closeImages(images);
517        PaintLogger.warnf("   Recording cancelled.");
518        return new TrackMateResults(false);
519    }
520}
